templates.title: Easy trail run
templates.summary: Time-on-feet on terrain — aerobic base with proprioception

warmup.detail: Easy jog on flat 6 min. Ankle mobility. 2 × 30 s on easy trail to preview footing.

main.detail: Easy trail run {main_min} min. Power-hike steep sections. Keep effort conversational on flats.

cooldown.detail: Walk 5 min. Stretch calves and ankles.

templates.title: Trail hill repeats (8×60 s)
templates.summary: Uphill power for trail and vert races

warmup.detail: Easy jog 8 min. Leg swings. 2 × 30 s moderate uphill.

main.detail_intro: Short quick steps uphill. Walk technical descents.

templates.title: Vert long run
templates.summary: Elevation-specific durability — ultra and skyrunning prep

warmup.detail: Easy jog 10 min. Ankle and hip prep.

main.detail: Long trail run {main_min} min with significant vert. Power-hike climbs >15%. Run flats and gentle descents. Fuel every 45 min.

cooldown.detail: Walk 10 min. Calf and hip stretch. Rehydrate.

templates.title: Downhill eccentric repeats
templates.summary: Eccentric loading for descents — quad durability

warmup.detail: Easy jog 10 min. 2 × 30 s gentle downhill to preview.

main.detail_intro: Short quick steps, lean slightly forward. Stop if quads scream or form breaks.

cooldown.detail: Easy jog flat 8 min. Quad stretch.

templates.title: Technical trail skills
templates.summary: Footwork and proprioception — roots, rocks, uneven terrain

warmup.detail: Easy jog 8 min. Ankle circles, single-leg balance 30 s/side.

main.detail: Easy trail run on technical terrain {main_min} min. Focus on eyes up, short steps, active feet. No pace goals — skill only.

templates.title: Trail fartlek (vert)
templates.summary: Unstructured hard/easy on terrain — race-specific effort management

main.detail_intro: Use terrain as the interval — power-hike steeps on hard sections.

templates.title: Trail race-pace simulation
templates.summary: Race-effort on similar terrain — pacing and fueling practice

warmup.detail: Easy jog 12 min. Include 2 × 1 min at race feel.

main.detail: 2 × 20 min at trail race effort on rolling terrain with 5 min easy between. Practice fueling and power-hiking strategy.

templates.title: Hike-run long
templates.summary: Ultra strategy — hike the climbs, run the rest

main.detail: Hike-run {main_min} min: hike all climbs >12%, run everything else easy. Practice poles if using them in your race.

cooldown.detail: Walk 10 min. Stretch calves and hips.
